events.verdict: Rivers (HOU) makes contact to the arm of Zubac (LAL) during his shooting motion that affects his shot attempt near the rim.
[Observable in Enhanced Video] RAR shows Tucker (HOU) gathers the ball and takes more than two steps prior to his jump shot attempt.
LLS & RLS Tucker (HOU) makes hand on ball contact with Ingram (LAL) during his shooting motion on the jump shot attempt and that contact is deemed incidental.
[Observable in Enhanced Video] Harden (HOU) lifts his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Harden (HOU) makes marginal contact with Caldwell-Pope (LAL) during the step back and doesn't affect his ability to defend the jump shot attempt.
Zubac (LAL) is not in a wide stance when the foot to foot contact occurs with Rivers (HOU) during the pick.
Gordon (HOU) makes marginal contact to the body of Zubac (LAL) during his shooting motion that does not affect his play at the basket.

Tucker (HOU) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Stephenson (LAL) and delivers some contact but he goes to and not through the defender. Stephenson's (LAL) reaction is not consistent with the level of contact.
Harden (HOU) kicks his legs out unnaturally when the marginal contact with Caldwell-Pope (LAL) occurs in his landing area.
Harden (HOU) briefly grabs Zubac's (LAL) jersey during the rebound.
Caldwell-Pope (LAL) commits a take foul on Harden (HOU).
Gordon (HOU) commits a take foul on Zubac (LAL).
Caldwell-Pope (LAL) maintains a legal guarding position during the jump shot attempt by Gordon (HOU).
Zubac (LAL) makes contact to the body of Hilario (HOU) during his shooting motion that affects his shot attempt near the rim.
[Observable in Enhanced Video] Tucker (HOU) enters the lane prior to the release of the ball during the free throw attempt.
Tucker (HOU) gives Ingram (LAL) room to land on the jump shot attempt.
Ingram (LAL) cleanly blocks Hilario's (HOU) shot attempt near the rim.
Harden (HOU) initiates contact with Caldwell-Pope (LAL) during the step back but doesn't affect his ability to defend the jump shot attempt.
Tucker (HOU) initiates marginal contact with Kuzma (LAL) during the rebound.
Stephenson (LAL) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he is imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Zubac (LAL) maintains a legal guarding position during the driving shot attempt by Harden (HOU).
Harden (HOU) briefly grabs Zubac's (LAL) jersey during the rebound.
Zubac (LAL) makes contact to the arm of Harden (HOU) during his shooting motion that affects his shot attempt near the rim.
Rivers (HOU) briefly places a hand/arm to the front of Ingram (LAL) during the drive.
Tucker (HOU) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Caldwell-Pope (LAL) and doesn't deliver contact.
Kuzma (LAL) makes contact to the body of Harden (HOU) during his shooting motion that affects his driving shot attempt.
Tucker (HOU) pulls Ingram's (LAL) hand off the ball during the rebound.
Hart (LAL) commits a take foul on Gordon (HOU).
[Observable in Enhanced Video] McGee (LAL) enters the lane prior to the release of the ball during the free throw attempt.
Ingram (LAL) briefly grasps the jersey of Harden (HOU) off ball.
Tucker (HOU) makes incidental hand on ball contact with Kuzma (LAL).
Hart (LAL) commits a take foul on Gordon (HOU).
